goal: Ensure that the authoritative formal reflection/native-4K evidence path actually contains the already-developed high-value facade rough-opening construction, metric physical UVs, deterministic apartment occupancy variation and 4 mm glass-edge construction before any reflection baseline can be sealed.

sourceFinding.problem: The canonical native-4K preparation path explicitly rebuilt DanchiFacadeOptics and environment lighting, but the physical aperture shell and occupancy-variation passes were separate editor operations with no observed direct invocation from that path. Source-quality improvements can therefore exist in the repository yet be absent from scoreable prepared pixels.
sourceFinding.risk: A facade-optics-only formal scene can retain the opaque MainBlock fallback/opening-depth mismatch and thirty-window clone read, weakening Geometry & construction, Period authenticity, Material/PBR and repetition performance without violating the previous reflection material/UV guards.
sourceFinding.priorityDecision: Fix authoritative evidence-path integration before adding another speculative asset. Additional visual detail has low value if the formal packet can omit previously completed geometry/material work.

implementation: Added QualityBlockFacadeFormalBuildBinding and linked it into QualityBlockReflectionMaterialPhysicalityBindingQA, an existing fingerprint path evaluated before ReflectionProbe.RenderProbe and re-evaluated through the formal reflection lifecycle.

For a new DanchiFacadeOptics preparation epoch, the binding requires the optics baseline first, then creates a missing DanchiFacadeApertureShell, bakes its world-aligned physical UVs, creates missing deterministic apartment curtain/track occupancy variation, and validates the sceneSaving-bound 4 mm glass-edge construction before the reflection baseline is armed.
Existing aperture/UV/occupancy state is validated rather than silently rewritten. Authored danchi replacement remains authoritative and bypasses generated-fallback enforcement.

Added facade_formal_build_binding_contract.json with machine-readable dependency order, canonical critical-defect risk IDs, required native-4K/crop evidence, zero automatic Visual Fidelity points and an explicit ban on earthquake/disaster/reconstruction themes.
The contract now requires report-free reflection polling and hard failure on in-flight root replacement under the same optics epoch.

After first pre-probe preparation, the binding freezes Unity instance IDs for optics/aperture/occupancy. Subsequent reflection polls under the same optics instance do not rebuild scene state; they validate a report-free aperture fingerprint plus full physical-UV, occupancy and glass-thickness QA.

selfAudit.finding: The first implementation reused QualityBlockFacadeApertureConstructionQA.ValidateOpenScene on every reflection fingerprint poll.
selfAudit.whyItWasWrong: That validator writes facade_aperture_installation_runtime_report.json and refreshes the AssetDatabase. Repeating it while a ReflectionProbe may be in flight violates the existing report-free evidence-fingerprint design and could mutate evidence state during capture.
selfAudit.correction: Introduced a facade-optics preparation epoch. Full aperture validation/reporting is allowed only before the probe baseline is armed. Later polls use a report-free structural fingerprint (MainBlock disabled, 120 facade cell parts, 120 seals, 60 apartment panes) plus non-reporting UV/occupancy/glass validators. Missing/replaced roots under the same optics instance now abort instead of auto-repairing.

selfAudit.finding: Merely documenting report-free behavior in prose would allow later contract drift.
selfAudit.correction: Added reflectionPollValidationMustBeReportFree=true and inFlightRootReplacementMustAbort=true to the machine-readable contract and enforced both booleans in QualityBlockFacadeFormalBuildBinding.ValidateContractConfigOnly.

expectedScoreImpactOnly: Geometry & construction fidelity (20): positive candidate impact because formal evidence can no longer omit the 0.22 m RC aperture shell/perimeter seals and fall back to the opaque MainBlock construction state; no points without actual pixels.

Material/PBR physical plausibility (20): positive candidate impact because world-aligned facade UVs, physical curtain cloth/track materials and 4 mm glass edges are now formal-path dependencies; actual BRDF/transmission remains unobserved.
Texture/microdetail/texel fidelity (10): positive candidate impact from guaranteeing metric physical aperture UVs before reflection/stills; rendered texel density/repetition remains unscored.

Period accuracy/scene authenticity (7): positive candidate impact from deterministic lived-in curtain variation replacing thirty identical dark-window interiors in the scoreable generated fallback; period plausibility still requires pixel review.

Lighting/shadows/reflections (15): positive candidate impact because probes should now see the same aperture depth, curtains and glass-edge construction used by stills; actual reflection balance/light leaks remain unverified.
Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability (5): neutral/risk pending because curtain LOD and 4 mm glass edges require temporal pixels to rule out pop/shimmer.
